title: eKYC verification timing out
alert: kyc-service vendor timeouts at 35%; customer vikram.t@outlook.com stuck at onboarding
root cause: The eKYC vendor lowered our rate limit and requests above it hung until timeout
fix: Added a token-bucket queue at the new vendor limit and retried queued verifications

title: Users logged out repeatedly
alert: auth-service session not found errors; Redis evicted_keys climbing
root cause: Redis hit maxmemory and allkeys-lru evicted live sessions
fix: Raised Redis maxmemory, switched to volatile-lru and moved sessions to a dedicated Redis

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=55%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during the Diwali sale used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
failed fixes: Bulk-retrying failed OTPs (made the throttling worse)
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: HikariPool-1 connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. p99 latency 6.4s
root cause: maxPoolSize was 20 and idle-in-transaction sessions held connections open during month-end settlements
failed fixes: Restarting payments-api pods (timeouts returned within minutes)
fix: Killed idle-in-transaction sessions and raised maxPoolSize from 20 to 60

title: Convenience fee charged twice
alert: Convenience fee doubled on bill payments after release 212
root cause: A config typo in the release applied the fee rule twice
failed fixes: Hotfixing forward without tests (introduced a second bug)
fix: Rolled back the release and refunded the fee difference
